label: Dark energy
summary: Research program on the cause of late-time cosmic acceleration.

label: Late-time cosmic acceleration
summary: Observed accelerated expansion whose physical cause remains unresolved.

label: LambdaCDM
summary: Standard cosmological model with cold dark matter and a cosmological constant.

label: Cosmological constant as dark energy
summary: Constant vacuum-energy explanation of acceleration; current datasets test departures from it.

label: wCDM
summary: Extension allowing a constant dark-energy equation-of-state parameter w.

label: w0waCDM
summary: Extension allowing dark energy to evolve with scale factor.

label: Evolving dark energy
summary: Hypothesis that dark-energy density or equation of state changes over cosmic time.

label: Baryon acoustic oscillations
summary: Standard-ruler method for constraining cosmic expansion.

label: DESI DR2 BAO cosmology
summary: DESI first-three-year BAO cosmology results released in 2025.

label: DESI DR2 Lyman-alpha full-shape
summary: 2026 Lyman-alpha full-shape constraints whose central value shifts toward LambdaCDM.

label: DES Year 6 dark-energy constraints
summary: Full DES multi-probe constraints testing constant and evolving dark-energy models.
